implemented_requirements.evidence: W = H = 80  # defined at top of main.py

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player movement using W/A/S/D keys (up, left, down, right)
implemented_requirements.evidence: DIRS = {"w": (0, -1), "a": (-1, 0), "s": (0, 1), "d": (1, 0)} and in main loop: if k in DIRS: game.move(*DIRS[k])

implemented_requirements.requirement: Movement only on floor tiles (.) and blocked by walls (#)
implemented_requirements.evidence: In Game.move(): if self.grid[ny][nx] == "#": self.log("A wall blocks your way.") and return

implemented_requirements.requirement: Goal door that advances to the next level when reached
implemented_requirements.evidence: self.door = (W - 3, H - 3) and in move(): if (nx, ny) == self.door: self.level += 1; self.build_level()

implemented_requirements.requirement: Monsters encountered; combat subtracts monster HP from player HP
implemented_requirements.evidence: In move(): if m: self.hp -= m["hp"]; self.monsters.remove(m); self.log("Fought %s ... -%d HP." % (m["name"], m["hp"]))

implemented_requirements.requirement: HP restored by 20–30 points when touching a treasure chest
implemented_requirements.evidence: If (nx, ny) in self.chests: heal = self.rng.randint(20, 30); self.hp = min(self.max_hp, self.hp + heal)

implemented_requirements.requirement: At least one valid path from start to door
implemented_requirements.evidence: Maze generated with randomized DFS (perfect maze) guaranteeing connectivity; door placed on an odd cell which is carved into a floor during generation.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Minimal UI displaying current HP and last monster stats
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.draw() builds a panel with "HP: %d/%d" and, if self.last_monster, shows Name, HP, ATK of the last monster.

judge.summary: The provided code implements an 80x80 roguelike with W/A/S/D movement, wall collision, a reachable door, monsters whose HP is subtracted from the player, treasure chests that heal 20‑30 HP, guaranteed path connectivity via a DFS maze, and a simple terminal UI showing HP and monster info. All core requirements are satisfied and the program appears ready to run.
